summary: Phase 3 still NOT STARTED after this session. Deep design analysis confirmed that the nested buildRight approach is correct but identified additional implementation obstacles: (1) P2_gen with all-same-point env (fun _ => t) cannot handle multi-variable parent environments needed for 3-var conditions at depth k > 0, (2) standalone sub-formulas for inner conditions cannot reference the outer Until witness x, (3) the formula must be a SINGLE nested structure with k+1 levels of buildRight, not decomposed into standalone sub-formulas. The handoff 20260611h documents the definitive design resolution. Import restructuring is also needed: remove KampPrior import from NegationClosure, add NegationClosure import to KampPrior.

blockers.description: P2(k+1) backward requires replacing nf_exist_formula with a SINGLE nested buildRight formula (k+1 levels of nesting). The formula is defined recursively on k, with buildRight placing witnesses at each level. At depth 0 (base case), the existing nf_exist_formula/backward_depth0 suffices. At depth k+1, the event formula at each witness includes a RECURSIVE call for deeper quantifier conditions.
blockers.estimated_fix: ~400 lines: recursive formula definition (~100), forward direction (~100), backward direction (~200)
key_obstacles: Formula must be a single nested structure, not decomposed into standalone sub-formulas
Inner conditions involve x (the outer Until witness) which is not accessible from standalone formulas at t
P2_gen(k, n) with env=(fun _ => t) fails for n > 1 because order atoms between parents are all false
The recursion is on k (depth) with increasing arity at each level, terminating at depth 0 where NFs are atoms
blockers.correct_approach: Define nf_exist_formula_nested by recursion on k. Base: nf_exist_formula. Step: buildRight chain placing x and interval witnesses, with nested calls in event formulas. Disjunction over compatible (nf_x, witness_config) pairs. Finite by Fintype instances.
